record.bible_text: Then Joseph<WH03130> came<WH0935><WTH8799> and told<WH05046><WTH8686> Pharaoh<WH06547>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, My father<WH01> and my brethren<WH0251>, and their flocks<WH06629>, and their herds<WH01241>, and all that they have, are come out<WH0935><WTH8804> of the land<WH0776> of Canaan<WH03667>; and, behold, they <FI>are<Fi> in the land<WH0776> of Goshen<WH01657>.
